integrity: Self-contained all-rank induction and fully enumerative finite regression code are included. Existing examples and relevant primary papers are credited. No independent scientific validation or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The alphabet is strictly ordered a_1<...<a_n; the theorem concerns finite literal Zimin words only, not arbitrarily ordered alphabets or pattern images. Finite checker ranks 1--9 do not prove the infinite-rank claim. Existing work establishes the diagonal half-Zimin examples. Historical-priority uncertainty remains.
title: Complete Lyndon-factor and occurrence spectra of finite Zimin words
